newsitem.title: CANADA: Parkland to acquire Yukon marketing firm.
newsitem.headline: Parkland to acquire Yukon marketing firm.

text.p: Parkland Industries Ltd said on Thursday it agreed to buy Whitehorse, Yukon-based Northern Petroleum for C$1.5 million.
Parkland said the price would include deferred payments of C$350,000 and the assumption of a C$2250,000 real estate mortgage.
Northern Petroleum operates seven independent gas stations, a retail heating oil business, contract fuel service and a trucking arm.
The acquisition was expected to add about C$500,000 to Parkland's pre-tax earnings over the next year, it said.
The deal was to be effective on February 1, 1997.
